_meta.indication: TAVALISSE is indicated for the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) who have had an insufficient response to a previous treatment.

pivotal_trials.population: Adult (age ≥ 18 years) patients with ITP for at least 3 months, average baseline platelet count < 30,000/mL, who had previously received at least 1 typical regimen for ITP
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Achievement of a stable platelet response by Week 24, defined as a platelet count of at least 50,000/mL on at least 4 of the last 6 scheduled visits between Weeks 14-24
pivotal_trials.result: Stable platelet response in 9 patients (17.6%) on fostamatinib vs 0 (0%) on placebo; difference 17.6%, Fisher's exact test p-value 0.03, favoring fostamatinib

pivotal_trials.population: Adult (age ≥ 18 years) patients with ITP for at least 3 months, average baseline platelet count < 30,000/mL, who had previously received at least 1 typical regimen for ITP
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Achievement of a stable platelet response by Week 24, defined as a platelet count of at least 50,000/mL on at least 4 of the last 6 scheduled visits between Weeks 14-24
pivotal_trials.result: Stable platelet response in 8 patients (16.0%) on fostamatinib vs 1 (4.2%) on placebo; difference 11.8%, Fisher's exact test p-value 0.26

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥5% and more than placebo): diarrhea (31% vs 15%), hypertension (28% vs 13%), nausea (19% vs 8%), respiratory infection, dizziness, ALT/AST increased, rash, abdominal pain, fatigue, chest pain and neutropenia. Serious ADRs (each 1%): febrile neutropenia, diarrhea, pneumonia, and hypertensive crisis. Neutropenia occurred in 6% and febrile neutropenia in 1%.
target_moa: Fostamatinib is a prodrug converted in vivo to its active metabolite R406, an orally active, ATP-competitive small molecule inhibitor of spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK); R406 inhibits signal transduction of Fc-activating receptors and reduces antibody-mediated destruction of platelets.

advisory_committee.vote: This application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants.

orphan_indication.text: Fostamatinib was granted orphan designation in August 2015 for treatment of ITP in adult patients.

citations.quote: Fostamatinib is a new molecular entity (NME) that was granted orphan designation in August 2015 for this use.

summary.text: Fostamatinib (a new molecular entity) was reviewed as a standard NDA and granted orphan drug designation in August 2015 for treatment of ITP in adult patients. The application was not presented to any advisory committee, and was approved for the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult chronic ITP patients with insufficient response to prior treatment.
